title: —Monsieur de la Palice, Stephen sneered, was alive fifteen minutes before his death.
html_source:
Jacques de la Palice was a famous French Marshal who had an epitaph that was often misread for humorous effect. The epitaph read:

Ci gît Monsieur de La Palice: Si il' n'était pas mort, il ferait encore envie.

i.e. “Here lies Monsieur de la Palice: were he not dead, he would still be admired.”

A humorous misreading of this has the last word as “en vie” instead of “envie”, which makes it read idiotically as “were he not dead, he would still be alive.”
